# Welcome to PromptMatrix Community Discussions! 💬

This is the central forum for:
- 💡 **Ideas & RFCs**: Feature requests, architecture improvements, new LLM eval criteria
- 🙋‍♀️ **Q&A & Help**: Integration troubleshooting with LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenClaw, or custom agents
- 🚀 **Show and Tell**: Show off agent systems or pipelines you've built using PromptMatrix
- 📢 **Announcements**: Updates, release notes, and ecosystem news
